title: Six models read partially-installed when none are - and 16GB on disk belongs to nothing
description: The partial bar excludes deps of models that are universe-complete, while everything else calls a model installed at >=1 op; plus an uninstalled Boogu left a 10.59GB clip on disk.

attention.reason: Sweep needs one real uninstall after a server restart (routes/ has no hot-reload); 'swept 0' is a valid pass. Remote twin deliberately deferred to MPI-464.
